methods.name: Sea Slug quest skip
methods.note: Sea Slug alone takes you from 1 to 24; Fishing Contest and Freeing Pirate Pete bring it to 10,612 XP, level 27. Current Affairs adds 1,000 with 22 Sailing.

methods.name: Shrimps, sardines and herring
methods.note: Small net shrimps at Draynor or Lumbridge Swamp, then bait sardines from 5 and herring from 10 at the same spots. Drop the catch; about 7,500 an hour by 10.

methods.name: Fly fishing
methods.note: Trout and salmon with a fly rod and feathers, dropping the catch. Barbarian Village has a fire for cooking; the spots south-east of Prifddinas never move.

methods.name: Fly fishing (3-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect: herb and tar makes a roll every 3 ticks instead of 5; drop each fish between catches. The guides' fastest method to 58, and very click-intensive.

methods.name: Tempoross
methods.note: Mass worlds, loading the harpoonfish raw rather than cooked, with a regular harpoon; low effort, and it rewards the fish barrel. A crystal harpoon reaches 95,000 at 99.

methods.name: Aerial fishing
methods.note: Lake Molch with a cormorant, Fishing and Hunter XP together and no nets to supply. The rates assume Hunter close behind Fishing, about 1,950 catches an hour.

methods.name: Drift net fishing
methods.note: Chase shoals into drift nets under Fossil Island for Fishing and Hunter XP, about 104 nets an hour. Bring breathing gear or the Medallion of the Deep.

methods.name: Barbarian fishing
methods.note: Otto's Grotto with a barbarian rod (ask Otto) and feathers, dropping the fish. The 45 Agility and Strength are for leaping sturgeon, which the rates from 70 assume.

methods.name: Barbarian fishing (3-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect 3-tick with herb and tar, or cut the fish and eat the roe. Both ironman guides use it from 58; very click-intensive.

methods.name: Monkfish
methods.note: Piscatoris with a small net after Swan Song, banked for profit. With 75 Sailing a raft spot just north of the colony never moves and fills the cargo hold.

methods.name: Karambwan
methods.note: Fairy ring DKP with a vessel and karambwanji; the spots never move, so an inventory is hands-off. The rates allow for banking; a fish barrel adds about 10%.

methods.name: Deep sea trawling
methods.note: Your own linen trawling net on a boat, following shoals: krill, haddock, yellowfin, then halibut from 83; trains Sailing too. Bluefin need a hemp net (76 Sailing).

methods.name: Leechfin
methods.note: Vampyrium river with a big net, aligning it to each fish and dropping between waves. The rate allows for missed fish; the angler's outfit adds 2.5%.

methods.name: Infernal eels
methods.note: Inner Mor Ul Rek, so you must have shown a fire cape; oily rod (25 Herblore for the oil), bait and ice gloves. Tokkul, onyx bolt tips and scale shards pay.

methods.name: Minnows
methods.note: Fishing Guild platform, open once you show Kylie the full angler's outfit. Minnows trade for noted raw sharks at 40 each; the spot moves every 15 seconds.

methods.name: Anglerfish
methods.note: Port Piscarilius with sandworms; the sea spot north-east of the foodhall never moves, so a full cargo hold is very AFK. Diabolic worms roughly double the rate.

unverified: Sea Slug quest skip: Sea Slug 7,175 XP (30 Firemaking), Fishing Contest 2,437 (10 Fishing) and Freeing Pirate Pete 1,000 (31 Cooking) make 10,612, level 27 (Quest experience rewards); Current Affairs adds 1,000 (10 Fishing, 22 Sailing) and Crab Quest 3,000 (30 Fishing, 40 Sailing); the app carries all 13 quests with Fishing XP (98,149.4); no hourly rate, so never dealt

Shrimps, sardines and herring: 85% of non-stop catching from each fish's chart (small net every 6 ticks, bait every 5), held to the Free-to-play guide's 1,500 (shrimps), 3,000 (sardines) and 8,000 (herring); the 15 band (8,500, bait still ahead of anchovies) is the model's alone

Fly fishing: the guide's AFK column is 83 to 87% of non-stop catching (trout 32/192, salmon 16/96, a roll every 5 ticks); the bands are the lower of that column and 85%, which trims 20 to 50 by 1 to 2%; the Ironman Guide's 20,000 to 35,000 sits under the column

Fly fishing (3-tick): the guide's 3-tick column, 92 to 93% of a roll every 3 ticks, held to Wise Old Man main's 46,592 for 3-tick fly fishing at 30 to 46, so 40 to 46 read 46,600 and not 53,000; no efficiency table rates it from 47

Tempoross: the guide's not-cooking regular-harpoon rows at 35, 70, 80, 90 and 99 are 606 to 641 harpoonfish an hour by the page's XP formula; the 40, 50 and 60 bands are that formula at the 35 row's 606 an hour, as the guide has no rows between 35 and 70; the page's 74,000 at 99 for the regular harpoon equals its dragon column and does not fit, the guide's 70,000 does; Wise Old Man ironman's 32,000 for 35 to 60 is Tempoross for the fish barrel (cooking for permits), not this; the Ironman Guide's solo route gives 50,000

Aerial fishing: 85% of the page's 2,300 catches an hour, written by an anonymous editor on 16 October 2026 (2,400 in the guide, 2,200 on 30 September, 1,600 to 1,800 before the 19 August 2026 rework); every page row rebuilds from Mod Ash's roll within 0.2%; the bands assume Hunter at 35, 51, 68, 77, 87 and 99 as Fishing reaches each step, and a lower Hunter gives less, which req cannot say band by band

Drift net fishing: 1,041 shoals an hour (85% of the guide's best 1,200 to 1,250), the same hour as hunter.json; XP a shoal from the page's table, which matches its prose (50 at 50, 77 at 70) and the shoal page; Wise Old Man main implies 1,210 to 1,255 shoals, above every band; breathing gear (Pirate Pete started, or the Medallion of the Deep) cannot go in req

Barbarian fishing: the guide's AFK column is 82 to 89% of non-stop catching (sturgeon 8/64, salmon 16/96, trout 32/192, every 5 ticks); bands are the lower of that and 85%; req is 45 Agility and Strength because the bands from 70 assume leaping sturgeon and would be 12 to 17% high without them, while at 48 to 69 fly fishing is as fast; trout need only 15 and salmon 30; the fishing part of Barbarian Training is a talk with Otto, so the miniquest is not in req; the Ironman Guide's 65,000 to 71,750 at 99 is above non-stop catching

Barbarian fishing (3-tick): the guide's 3-tick column (94 to 95% of a roll every 3 ticks) held to Wise Old Man ironman's barblore rates (93,000 at 70 to 83, 98,600 at 84 to 90, 102,200 at 91 to 96, 104,300 at 97 to 98, 107,000 at 99), which cap it at 80 to 83, 90 to 96 and 99; 45 Agility and Strength as above

Monkfish: the guide's table (35,800 to 42,000, unchanged since 2022) is 98 to 102% of non-stop catching at a roll every 6 ticks (48/90; Module:Echo skill success chart and the action lengths page), so it is a ceiling and 85% of it is used; the guide's 3 to 4 minutes per inventory at sea counts spirit flakes and Rada's blessing; two pages say Swan Song completed, the boat spot's page says partial

Karambwan: the guide's figures assume a fish barrel; 10% off, as the guide says without one, gives 26,100 to 37,800; the Money making guide's 600 an hour at about 80 with no items (30,000) is 4.7% under, and non-stop catching (5/160, every 4 ticks) puts the bands at 80 to 83% of it; the Ironman Guide's pessimistic table (no barrel, quest cape or outfit) is 72%

Deep sea trawling: rebuilt from the fish pages (XP a catch, charts) at a roll every 3 ticks since 20 May 2026 and 85% of the hour on the shoal, as sailing.json; req is the linen net (65 Sailing, 61 Construction) because yellowfin and halibut swim at moderate depth; the guide's halibut row (33,000 to 36,000) sits on the maximum, its krill row (15,000 to 17,000) on the old 4-tick maximum; crewmate catches are not counted; bluefin (87, hemp net at 76 Sailing) and marlin (91, Northern Ocean) are not rated

Leechfin: 85% of the guide's table without the angler's outfit (90,400 at 78 to 107,800 at 99); the table is 4,360 to 4,400 attempts an hour with the outfit at every row, and the page's wave pattern (22 fish, then a lull long enough to cut 6 or 7) rebuilds 4,400 to 4,550; 33.2 XP a catch since 8 July 2026; a super fishing potion lets you start at 72 and keep going

Infernal eels: the guide's figures are 81% of non-stop catching (30/93, every 5 ticks) at every row, so they stand; 25 Herblore for blamish oil is now in req; the fire cape and ice gloves (the Ice Queen, past a 50 Mining rock) cannot go in req; semi, as the spots move every 1 to 3 minutes; a knife and hammer fit in the tackle box since 14 October 2026

Minnows: the table's XP column (40,000 to 56,000) and its minnow column (15,000 to 25,000 at 10 to 14 a catch) disagree from 85; the lower reading (the minnow column at 26.1 XP a catch with the outfit) is used; no catch chance is published; the full angler's outfit cannot go in req

Anglerfish: 85% of non-stop catching (3/36, every 5 ticks; Mod Ash: 14% a roll at 99); the guide's 23,000 at 90 is above non-stop catching; the Ironman Guide measured 169 an hour of fishing at 99 against 173 non-stop (15 October 2026); diabolic worms (79.2 XP, a Yama drop) roughly double the rate

Slimy and cave eels at the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon spot, which never moves (28 and 38, Death to the Dorgeshuun, a light source): on no guide or efficiency table and rated nowhere; by the chart alone (both 10/80, cascaded, every 5 ticks) 85% of non-stop catching is about 21,800 at 38, 32,300 at 65 and 43,500 at 99, which would make them the best AFK method from 38 and pass karambwan; left out until a page or a test rates them

Not included: 2-tick swordfish and tuna (71; with a regular harpoon slower than 3-tick barbarian fishing at every level, faster only with a dragon harpoon at 1.9 million coins or the crystal harpoon, and the guides send most players to barbarian fishing for its Strength and Agility XP); lantern harpooning (52, 47 Sailing, about 20,000 to 30,000 with a crystal harpoon); sacred eels (87, Regicide, 72 Cooking, 20,000 to 23,000, under karambwan); dark crabs (85, deep Wilderness, about 34,000 to 38,000 with the elite Wilderness Diary, level with karambwan); Camdozaal fish (7, Below Ice Mountain, about 5,600); barehanded harpooning (55, 10,000 to 24,000); Fishing Trawler; lobsters and non-tick tuna and swordfish, dropped by the guide in 2024
